name: Use Case Diagrams
practice_prompt: Coach the student to build a use case diagram for the scenario they chose. Follow the stage order. One question per turn — no full diagram yet.

practice_stages.label: end in mind
practice_stages.focus: Clarify what we're building — a use case diagram for the scenario they chose. Ask what they think the diagram should show at a high level.

practice_stages.label: actors
practice_stages.focus: Identify actors (Customer, Restaurant, Dasher, etc.). Ask who interacts with the system before listing use cases.

practice_stages.label: use cases
practice_stages.focus: Identify main use cases per actor (e.g. Place Order, Deliver Order). Ask the student to name them — don't list the full set.

practice_stages.label: system boundary
practice_stages.focus: Draw the system boundary — what's inside vs outside. Ask what belongs inside the DoorDash system box.

final_example: A complete DoorDash use case diagram with actors Customer, Restaurant, Dasher, Admin, Payment Gateway outside the system boundary; use cases like Browse Restaurants, Place Order, Accept Order, Deliver Order inside.
check_questions: What is an actor in a use case diagram? Give a simple example.
What is a use case? How is it different from an actor?
What does the system boundary represent?
